style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Bushy and beautiful, this HOMCOM artificial Christmas tree is the perfect centerpiece to make an impression this season. Completely bare, it gives you the freedom to dress it up with your favorite decorations and lights. Easy to set up, simply fit the sections together, let the hinged branches fall into place, and then shape them to your liking. The tree comes with a sturdy metal base to ensure it stands upright and steady. Key features include a thick and stable plastic construction for durability, flame-retardant material for safety, and a full, voluptuous design for a stunning look. With 1724 branch tips, this 5ft tree will add festive charm to your home. The tree’s overall dimensions are 95cm in diameter and 150cm in height. Item label: 830-888V00GN. Note: For indoor use only, not suitable for outdoor use. To achieve a full appearance, spread out all individual tips for the best possible look; shaping the tree should take about 10 minutes.
